title: Angular Developer
description:
About Phi Partners

Phi Partners is the a market leader for capital markets technology services providing technology & quant services, solutions, and expertise to buy-side and sell-side financial institutions including some of the world’s largest investment banks, hedge funds and asset management firms. Founded in 2004 and headquartered in London, Phi has a presence in all major continents. Our niche focus on Front Office Technology has been a differentiator and gateway into the world’s best financial institutions.

About Phi Partners Brazil

Phi Partners has nearshore Centres-of-Excellence which are specialized in respective ‘Lines of Business’ (LoBs). Our latest São Paulo Centre-of-Excellence, houses our Quant, Front Office & Risk Technology Services (FORTS) & Murex teams. The São Paulo Centre-of-Excellence was opened with the goal to strengthened Phi's current relationship with our North America clients, as well with global clients with presence in São Paulo. Joining us means diving into truly groundbreaking work, pushing the limits of what modern technology can deliver while solving high-impact challenges for top-tier clients. You’ll build cutting-edge solutions for the world’s largest Investment Banks, leading Asset Managers, and market-defining Hedge Funds, working on projects where innovation is not an extra, but a fundamental expectation in everything we deliver.

About The FORTS Practice

Phi Partners is one of the largest consultancies specializing FORTS, with a dedicated team of over 175 consultants spread across multiple locations. Our team is distinguished by deep expertise in front-office and risk technology solutions, empowering top-tier financial institutions to optimize their trading and risk management capabilities.

At Phi Partners, we are committed to a collaborative, high-performance culture where professionals work together to deliver complex front-office solutions to elite clients. We specialize in the end-to-end implementation of front-office and risk platforms, from initial requirements gathering to post-go-live support, ensuring that our clients are fully supported throughout the platform lifecycle. We focus on custom development and configuration, creating solutions that address unique client needs and regulatory requirements in real-time trading and risk management.

Additionally, we conduct extensive training and knowledge transfer sessions, ensuring client teams are equipped to maximize the value of their technology investments.

Key Responsibilities

• Design and develop robust, scalable applications supporting E-Trading systems across asset classes

• Work with trading, operations, and business teams to gather requirements and deliver effective solutions

• Apply sound design and architecture principles, using data structures and algorithms for performance

• Stay current with technologies and industry trends, particularly within algorithmic and e-Trading platforms

• Analyze and resolve system bottlenecks, performance issues, and application bugs

The Ideal candidate

• A minimum of five years of front-end development experience in the capital markets

• Advanced experience in building complex applications in Angular (version 15+)

• Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS, and SCSS

• Advanced knowledge of TypeScript, JavaScript, ES6, and RxJS

• Familiarity with Redux/NGRX-5

• Hands-on experience with automated testing, particularly using Jest

• Experience working with NX Monorepo

• Good interpersonal and communication skills, with professional English proficiency

Why should you join Phi Partners

Join us as we build the next-generation eTrading team, an ambitious, fast-growing group delivering world-class, complex, and genuinely exciting projects to major financial institutions around the globe. We’re in a pivotal expansion phase, working with leading-edge technologies and giving you the chance to shape our strategy, influence key architectural decisions, and deploy solutions that truly impact global Capital Markets. This is a rare opportunity to be part of a world-leading Capital Markets Technology Consultancy while working alongside one of the strongest banking organizations in the industry.

title: UX/UI Designer (E-Commerce Growth, CRO & A/B Testing)
description:
UX/ UI Designer – Swissker

Salary: USD $2,500 – $3,500/month

Location: Remote

Type: Full-time

About Swissker

Swissker is a US-based DTC e-commerce brand specializing in healthcare products that improve everyday wellbeing. We are a fast-growing company powered by data-driven decision-making, ongoing optimization, and a culture of experimentation.

Our focus is on creating high-performance funnels and product experiences that scale across multiple traffic sources and international markets.

Role Overview

We are looking for a UX Designer with strong experience in crafting high-converting user experiences for e-commerce. You will be responsible for designing funnels, advertorials, landing pages, PDPs, checkout flows, and other conversion-focused experiences used in A/B testing and continuous optimization.

You’ll collaborate with CRO, Marketing, Design, and Development teams to deliver clean, modern, and scalable Figma designs that directly impact revenue and KPIs.

This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design conversion-focused product pages, landing pages, funnels, advertorials, and checkout experiences in Figma.
  • Design versatile graphic assets for use across web pages, advertising creatives, and marketing campaigns, ensuring brand consistency and high visual impact.
  • Work closely with CRO Manager to turn hypotheses into testable UX/UI variations.
  • Create wireframes, high-fidelity layouts, UI components, and design documentation.
  • Collaborate with Developers to ensure accurate, high-quality implementation of designs.
  • Participate in experiment planning, UX reviews, and data-driven improvement discussions.
  • Analyze insights from A/B tests (preferable) and iterate on winning concepts.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience as a UX/UI Designer in web or e-commerce environments.
  • Strong proficiency with Figma, including components, auto-layout, variants, and prototyping.
  • Proven experience designing web pages, especially e-commerce or funnels.
  • Portfolio is mandatory (web projects, landing pages, funnels, product pages, etc.).
  • Strong understanding of responsive design and UI/UX best practices.
  • Good written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally in a fast-paced, highly structured environment.
  • Detail-oriented, organized, and able to follow processes and documentation standards.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in CRO, A/B testing, or experimentation-driven teams.
  • Experience creating graphic design assets for web experiences, digital ads, and marketing campaigns.
  • Familiarity with A/B testing tools, user behavior tools, and funnel analytics.
  • Experience in direct-response design or healthcare/e-commerce niches.
  • Strong understanding of UX heuristics and behavioral psychology.

Data Analysis is a plus

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary: $2,500 – $3,500 USD
  • Work in a highly data-driven environment with fast testing cycles
  • Opportunity to directly influence revenue and performance
  • 100% remote and flexible work environment
  • Growth opportunities in a rapidly expanding global DTC brand

title: Content Labeler / Moderator (Portuguese)
description:
Project Background(Toxic Words Labeling)

This project focuses on cleaning and annotating in-game voice content, with an emphasis on identifying sensitive language such as violent expressions and profanity. The resulting training data will help better distinguish ambiguous content and support overall content safety and user experience improvement.

Responsibilities

  1. Download the audio to your local computer through the audio link for playback.
  2. Determine whether the audio contains toxic words. If so, mark "Toxic" in the "Is toxic" column of the table. If the audio does not contain toxic words, mark "Normal"
  3. For words containing toxic, mark each time point of the toxic word in the "Note" column (if a word is repeated multiple times, the time point of each occurrence must be marked) and the toxic word, and its corresponding English translation
  4. List the 20 English translations of the most frequently occurring dirty words (it is not necessary to collect 20, as many as possible)

Requirements

  1. Native Portuguese based in Brazil, fluent in both spoken and written English (minimum B2 English level)
  2. Available 30-40 hours per week with relatively fixed daily schedule
  3. Up-to-date PC (Windows 10 or later) or Mac (Big Sur or later) with stable utility and internet connection
  4. Degree and/or working experience in literature, translation, linguistics, teaching is a plus
  5. Similar project experience in data collection, annotation, quality control, coordination is a plus

Training & Payment

  1. Each participant will attend approximately 1 hour of training
  2. Actual work will be paid based on completed cases.
  3. Estimated time per case is about 1 minute, based on internal testing.

Additional Notes

  1. The project is expected to run for approximately 3–4 weeks. Please ensure that you are able to remain available for the full project duration and meet the output targets as defined by the Project Manager.
  2. Once you confirm participation in this project, early withdrawal during the project period is not permitted

title: Content Writer (Portuguese) - 53457
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.

Role Overview:

We are looking for a detail-oriented Content Writer to create and refine content used in workflows, training data, and scenario-based evaluations for large language models (LLMs). You will help build realistic content samples, review AI-generated outputs, and ensure accuracy, clarity, and consistency.

What does day-to-day look like:

  • Create and edit content across formats such as articles, guides, workflows, and scenarios.
  • Recreate real-world content workflows for AI evaluation.
  • Review AI outputs for quality, accuracy, and adherence to guidelines.
  • Provide feedback and annotations to support LLM improvement.
  • Collaborate with product and AI teams to align content with operational needs.

Required Qualifications:

  • 2+ years experience as a Content Writer, Copywriter, or Technical Writer.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to identify content gaps or inconsistencies.
  • Familiarity with documentation or workflow tools (e.g., Confluence, Notion, Zendesk, Jira).
  • Excellent written communication skills.

Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.

Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : at least 4 hours per day and minimum 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 1 month

Evaluation Process :

  • Shortlisted candidates will be reviewed by our team internally and shortlisted candidates will be reached out for onboarding.

title: Director Restaurants Technology - Relocation to UAE
description:
Job Purpose:

The Director of Restaurant Technology is responsible for defining and leading the end-to-end technology strategy that powers Americana’s restaurant/QSR ecosystem across 2,600+ restaurants in 12 countries. This role provides strategic direction, governance, and execution oversight for all restaurant-facing technologies across dine-in, delivery, drive-thru, and pickup channels including POS systems, kitchen automation, digital menu boards, kiosks, handheld ordering, drive-thru technology, and transactional cost-control platforms.

The Director is accountable for ensuring that all technologies deployed within the restaurants are stable, secure, scalable, and aligned with brand, market, and operational requirements. The role partners closely with Operations, IT, Digital, Procurement, and vendor ecosystems to ensure technology delivers measurable value, improves customer experience, and enhances operational efficiency.

A core responsibility of this role is to lead the IT Service Management capability for all restaurant technologies. The Director builds and governs an ITIL-aligned support framework, ensuring disciplined, structured processes across:

  1. Incident Management (rapid and consistent issue resolution across markets)
  2. Problem Management (elimination of recurring issues through root-cause analysis)
  3. Change Management (controlled deployment of updates, patches, and enhancements)
  4. Release & Deployment Management (standardized, risk-free rollouts)
  5. Service Request & Knowledge Management (scalable and documented support models)
  6. Vendor, SLA & Compliance Management (ensuring partners deliver high uptime and quality)

The role ensures that all restaurants receive consistent, high-performing technology support, both onsite and remotely, enabling store managers and frontline teams to operate efficiently and deliver an exceptional customer experience. This leader continuously evaluates innovative and fit-for-purpose solutions that support Americana’s growth, operational excellence, and customer-centric mission.

Scope:

Restaurants Division Across All Markets.

Key Responsibilities:

As the largest restaurant operator in the MENA region, Americana Restaurants runs 2,600+ restaurants across 12 countries , representing world-leading brands including KFC, Pizza Hut, Hardee’s, Krispy Kreme, TGI Fridays, Wimpy, Peet’s Coffee , and several proprietary brands. The Director of Restaurant Technology plays a mission-critical role in enabling operational excellence, customer satisfaction, and scalable digital transformation across all these markets and brands.

Strategic Leadership & Technology Vision

  • Define and lead the Restaurant Technology strategy in alignment with executive leadership, including the CEO, Brand Leaders, CFO, COO, and Digital & Technology Heads.
  • Serve as the primary architect of restaurant technology innovation across all Americana ME markets : UAE, KSA, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman, Jordan, Egypt, Morocco, Kazakhstan, Lebanon, and beyond.
  • Collaborate with Group Technology teams including Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, Cloud, and Enterprise Applications to ensure restaurant-specific requirements are seamlessly delivered.

Design, Innovation & Customer Experience

  • Design, enhance, and customize technology systems that elevate customer experience, improve speed of service, and empower restaurant employees across all dine-in, drive-thru, delivery, and pickup channels.
  • Identify and implement innovative, fit-for-purpose solutions that strengthen Americana’s competitive advantage in the QSR and fast-casual sectors.

Restaurant Technology Systems & Platforms

  • Select and govern the right technologies to support multi-brand, multi-country operations, including (but not limited to):
  • POS Platforms (NCR Aloha)
  • Kitchen Automation & KDS (NCR)
  • Digital Menu Boards (DMB)
  • Self-Ordering Kiosks
  • Drive-Thru Systems
  • Handheld Ordering & Payments
  • Restaurant IoT & hardware ecosystems
  • Ensure consistent architecture, integrations, and performance across 2,600+ restaurants.

Implementation & Rollout Governance

  • Oversee the planning, implementation, pilot phases, and full deployment of all new restaurant systems across all brands and markets.
  • Provide strategic direction and technical oversight to internal teams, vendor partners, systems integrators, and implementation SMEs.
  • Own end-to-end rollout governance including testing cycles, cutover planning, migration, training, documentation, and hyper care.

Stakeholder Collaboration & Business Alignment

  • Partner with Brand Leadership, Operations Excellence, Supply Chain, Finance, Digital, and Market GMs to ensure technology solutions meet business needs.
  • Drive clarity in business requirements, end-to-end process mapping, and UAT planning for new and existing systems.

Vendor, Procurement & Technology Partnerships

  • Approve the procurement of technology hardware, software, and services to meet the needs of Americana restaurants across regions.
  • Build and maintain strong partnerships with global and regional vendors (POS vendors, device manufacturers, payment providers, network partners, kiosk suppliers, etc.).
  • Manage contractual SLAs, performance KPIs, service-level governance, and vendor compliance.

ITIL-Aligned Service Management & BAU Excellence

  • Establish and enforce ITIL-driven processes for:
  • Incident Management
  • Problem Management
  • Change & Release Management
  • Service Request Fulfillment
  • Knowledge & Configuration Management
  • Ensure all business-as-usual (BAU) activities are delivered within SLAs across all countries and brands.
  • Lead continuous service improvement (CSI) initiatives to enhance system stability, reduce downtime, and increase operational efficiency.

Team Leadership & Operating Model Optimization

  • Build and optimize a high-performing Restaurant Technology team with the right mix of skills across markets.
  • Define an operating model that combines in-house capabilities with strategic outsourcing for non-core functions, ensuring scalability and efficiency.
  • Provide coaching, development opportunities, and succession planning to ensure long-term organizational strength.

Innovation, Market Intelligence & Competitive Advantage

  • Stay ahead of global QSR and retail technology trends (AI automation, predictive cooking, contactless ordering, robotics, IoT, smart drive-thru, etc.).
  • Continuously evaluate advancements that can be piloted and scaled across Americana restaurants to improve operational performance, reduce cost, and enhance customer experience.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field is required.
  • A master’s in technology, Computer Science, or an MBA is strongly preferred and considered a significant advantage.
  • Additional certifications in ITIL, Cloud Technologies, POS Systems are desirable.

Experience:

  • 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in a large multi-market and/or multi-brand Quick Service Restaurant companies- this is mandatory due to the scale and operational complexity of the role. Optional areas of experience could be multi market Retail, or Hospitality also among others.
  • Proven experience managing large, geographically distributed teams across multiple countries or regions.
  • Demonstrated capability in leading major transformation initiatives within a retail or restaurant technology ecosystem, including modernization, digitalization, and operational change.
  • Extensive experience working within a franchise-driven operating model of comparable size and complexity to Americana (multi-brand, multi-country, high-volume operations).
  • Strong background in designing, architecting, and implementing restaurant IT systems, including POS, kitchen automation, kiosks, drive-thru, digital menu boards, handheld ordering, and related store technologies.
  • Deep experience in end-to-end IT implementation lifecycle including strategy, design, development, rollout, testing, UAT, deployment, and hyper care.
  • Hands-on experience collaborating with cross-functional teams and global vendors, managing SLAs, and driving service excellence in a high-pressure operational environment.

Knowledge:

  • Strong knowledge and work experience with POS NCR Aloha or close equivalent is a must
  • Excellent knowledge of Restaurant Technology systems and infrastructure, knowledge of NCR

Skills:

  • Superior analytical and problem-solving capabilities
  • A strong strategic and business mindset
  • Excellent organizational and leadership skills
  • Outstanding communication and interpersonal abilities
  • Has the ability to extract and distill requirements, and know how to turn these into reality using technology
  • Strong business relationship management skills and stakeholder management
  • Attention to detail and excellent time management skills
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast paced, dynamic environment – ability to deal with ambiguity and think outside the box
  • Strong vendor management skills

This is a relocation role to the UAE — please apply only if interested.

title: Key Account Manager
description:
About Us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage! Within just one year, Keeta has become an industry leader in Hong Kong. With our ongoing expansions into Saudi Arabia, Keeta achieved the remarkable feat of launching 5 cities in just 17 days, allowing the Arab world to witness the speed of China! Keeta offers exciting opportunities to join a transformative journey that is shaping the future of delivery and retail. Join Keeta, explore the world.

What You'll Do

  • Responsible for the development and operation of regional chain brands, driving user acquisition and scale growth for assigned brands, leading the team to execute the company's sales strategies, and achieving performance targets.
  • Promote deep collaboration between regional chain brands and the platform in areas such as brand marketing, promotional activities, and user operations, enhancing the partnership and stickiness between the brands and Keeta.
  • Based on the characteristics of the food and beverage industry, develop a deep understanding of categories and brand operation models, identify business development opportunities, and formulate tactical plans covering (but not limited to) growth, marketing, user experience, and membership programs to strengthen Keeta’s influence within the industry.
  • Establish strong communication with the delivery department, acting as a bridge between brands and the platform’s delivery operations, and work collaboratively to continuously optimize the brand delivery service experience.
  • Fully leverage personal work potential, gather frontline marketing information, user feedback, and local market dynamics to provide valuable insights and references for the company's decision-making.

What We Need From You

  • Have excellent business negotiation and market development capabilities, be loyal to business goals, have insight into the needs of users, and be brave to embrace challenges.
  • Have basic data analysis skills and master office software applications. Experience in working with charts/graphs is required.
  • Integrity, honesty and resilience. Passionate about work and possessing a strong team spirit.
  • English and Portuguese can be used as working languages.

Why Join Keeta

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a clear vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan's global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career.

As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You'll be part of a company that's transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences.

At Keeta, you'll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 94 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, and beyond.

Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You'll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let's build the future of food delivery.

title: Assistente de Field
description:

Sua missão é garantir que o hardware e o ambiente de software (incluindo o ecossistema TOTVS) funcionem sem interrupções, minimizando o tempo de inatividade e elevando os níveis de satisfação dos clientes internos e externos através de um atendimento ágil e resolutivo.

O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Realizar o suporte técnico de Nível 1 e 2 aos usuários locais, solucionando problemas de hardware e software que não puderam ser resolvidos remotamente.

  • Realizar o setup completo de novas máquinas (instalação de Sistema Operacional, pacotes de produtividade como ferramentas Gooigle e ferramentas de comunicação).
  • Garantir que as estações de trabalho tenham os pré-requisitos necessários para rodar os sistemas TOTVS (navegadores homologados, certificados digitais, drivers de impressoras fiscais/térmicas).
  • Apoiar na atualização de pacotes e correções de software nas máquinas dos usuários conforme as diretrizes da TI Central.
  • Manter atualizada a base de dados de ativos de TI, registrando movimentações, entradas de novos equipamentos e termos de responsabilidade
  • Zelar pelo estoque de peças de reposição (memórias, mouses, teclados, cabos) e insumos de informática
  • Prestar apoio básico na conectividade física, como testes de pontos de rede, substituição de cabos de rede e verificação de funcionamento de switches no rack local.
  • Cumprir os prazos de atendimento e solução estabelecidos, garantindo que o usuário não fique parado por longos períodos.
  • Registrar detalhadamente todas as atividades realizadas no sistema de chamados (Zendesk.), alimentando a base de conhecimento
  • Auxiliar na implementação de novos projetos de TI da unidade, como trocas em massa de equipamentos (rollout) ou mudanças de layout de escritório.
  • Orientar os usuários sobre as melhores práticas de uso dos equipamentos e segurança da informação.
  • Acompanhar visitas técnicas de terceiros (manutenção de ar-condicionado do CPD, links de internet ou garantia de fabricantes).

O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Montagem, manutenção e diagnóstico de desktops e notebooks (substituição de peças, upgrades).
  • Domínio de Windows 10 e 11 (instalação, configuração e resolução de erros).
  • Conhecimento básico em redes (configuração de IP, teste de cabos, conectividade Wi-Fi e entendimento de VPN).
  • Suporte a Gmail, Chat, Teams, OneDrive e Word/Excel.
  • Configuração de impressoras (locais e em rede), scanners, coletores de dados e projetores.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas como Logmein ou Microsoft Remote Desktop.

SERIA LEGAL SE TIVESSE:

  • Familiaridade básica com a estrutura de sistemas TOTVS (Protheus, RM ou Fluig) será um grande diferencial.
  • Certificações: Desejável: ITIL v4 Foundation, CompTIA A+ ou certificações Microsoft (MD-100/101).
  • Nível técnico para leitura de manuais e termos de sistemas.
  • Já ter trabalhado com ferramentas de abertura e gestão de chamados (ex: ServiceNow, Jira, GLPI).

title: QAQC Senior Analyst
description:
Downtown Engineers (DWT ENG) is a fast-growing, New York-based, MEP engineering firm that has completed over 300 projects and designed more than 3 million square feet of built space in NY.

We’re hiring a Brazil-based, remote professional to own and scale our QAQC design process so every project consistently meets our standards as we grow.

Important

This role is not about line-by-line reviewing design deliverables. Instead, you will ensure the design process is executed correctly and that all quality-check steps are completed on 100% of projects, minimizing design errors, communication breakdowns, and rework.

Compensation & Structure

  • Full-time (remote)
  • Competitive total compensation

What you’ll do

  • Own the QAQC process end-to-end across MEP projects: define, implement, and continuously improve checklists, stage gates, and “definition of done” criteria.
  • Guarantee compliance: ensure all required quality checks are completed (with traceability) on every project—no exceptions.
  • Standardize workflows: templates, file organization, naming conventions, coordination routines, handoff requirements, and internal documentation.
  • Improve communication and handoffs: reduce information loss between teams, disciplines, and stakeholders.
  • Track quality metrics: build dashboards and weekly reporting around nonconformities, rework drivers, cycle time, recurring errors, and process adherence.
  • Root-cause and prevention: investigate failures, implement corrective actions, and ensure improvements stick.

Requirements

  • Advanced English (written + spoken) to work with a US-based team and clients.
  • Experience in AEC/MEP environments (MEP design, engineering, BIM coordination, project delivery, design ops, PMO, QA/QC)
  • Strong process ownership mindset: disciplined, organized, and consistent follow-through.
  • Ability to drive compliance across teams (without being the “reviewer of everything”).
  • Comfortable creating SOPs, checklists, and governance routines that scale.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with tools like Revit, AutoCAD, Bluebeam, ACC/BIM 360, Asana/Monday/Jira, etc.
  • Track record of improving quality and reducing rework through better systems.

Selection Process

  1. Application: apply to the opportunity, submitting the form with you CV, English experience and CRM background
  2. Screening: English and communication assessment
  3. Sales case: short technical challenge
  4. Interviews: with leadership and our CEO
  5. Offer

Why join Downtown?

  • Strategic role in a fast-growing NYC company
  • Our clients love us
  • Strong engineering team in all trades
  • Startup mentality towards growth and team building
  • We only hire people who excel

PLURAL

Iguais e diferentes. Singulares e plurais. Acreditamos que a diversidade nos fortalece, por isso, não fazemos distinção entre candidatos seja por deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça/etnia, idade, origem, constituição familiar ou estética. Aqui você pode descobrir novos desafios, novos horizontes, novos objetivos e até mais sobre si mesmo!

O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER?

  • Criar modelos e ensembles de modelos usando técnicas combinadas de Machine Learning, estatística e otimização para solução de problemas de negócio;
  • Construir e gerenciar análises de múltiplas bases de dados de grande volume usando diversas ferramentas técnicas (SQL, Python, Excel) para criar análises fundadas com qualidade e rigor;
  • Desenvolver modelos de otimização linear inteira, inteira mista, algoritmos evolutivos modelos utilizando técnicas de Inteligência Artificial para solução de problemas de negócio;

  • Trabalhar em modelo ágil e de forma colaborativa dentro de squads;
  • Definir junto com times de parceiros de tecnologia requisitos de Arquitetura, Segurança e Infraestrutura para garantir robustez e automação nas soluções desenvolvidas.

QUEM NOS INSPIRA?

  • Alguém que acredite em nossos valores;
  • Com iniciativa;
  • Perfil analítico;
  • Que proponha ideias e soluções.

O QUE A SUZANO ESPERA DE VOCÊ?

  • Conhecimento prático em ferramentas e bibliotecas de ciência de dados (Python, SQL, R, Excel);

Cuidados da sua saúde: Plano Médico, Odonto e Seguro de Vida;

VR ou Refeitório, VA para ajudar nas compras do mercado e, no final do ano, VA adicional;

title: Desenvolvedor de Sistemas | IA & Automação Inteligente
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Atividades que este profissional irá exercer :

  • Desenvolver e implementar fluxos de automação inteligentes e agentes de IA utilizando a plataforma LangFlow e ferramentas similares.
  • Projetar e otimizar interações com Modelos de Linguagem (LLMs) aplicando técnicas avançadas de Engenharia de Prompt e Contexto.
  • Desenvolver e sustentar aplicações back-end robustas utilizando NodeJS e interfaces front-end modernas com ReactJS e NextJS.
  • Realizar customizações e integrações em plataformas de Inteligência Artificial corporativa.
  • Criar e manter scripts de automação eficientes em Python e NodeJS para tarefas operacionais e de dados.
  • Integrar fluxos de IA com sistemas legados e corporativos (ERP, CRM) através do consumo e criação de APIs REST.
  • Modelar e manter soluções de dados utilizando bancos relacionais, NoSQL e bancos vetoriais para suporte às aplicações de IA.
  • Colaborar ativamente com as áreas de negócio para mapear processos, levantar requisitos e traduzi-los em especificações técnicas viáveis.
  • Executar testes contínuos (unitários e integrados) para assegurar a performance, segurança e confiabilidade das automações.

Experiência :

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de aplicações e automações de software .
  • Conhecimento prático em JavaScript / TypeScript .
  • Vivência com NodeJS para integração e suporte às automações.
  • Experiência no consumo e desenvolvimento de APIs REST .
  • Experiência em análise funcional , entendimento de processos e desenho de fluxos.
  • Conhecimento aplicado em engenharia de prompt para LLMs .
  • Experiência com testes automatizados .
  • Atuação em ambientes ágeis (Scrum / Kanban).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de versionamento de código ( Git ).

Skills técnicos:

  • Sólidos conhecimentos em NodeJS (Javascript/Typescript).
  • Desenvolvimento e consumo de APIs REST.
  • Técnicas e metodologias de teste, incluindo BDD (Behavior-Driven Development).
  • Compreensão profunda dos princípios de Engenharia de Prompts para LLMs.

Hey, Dingus!

Yeah, you heard that right.

Dingus & Zazzy is looking for a motivated, ambitious Graphic Designer to join our growing team!

Dingus & Zazzy is a comprehensive digital marketing agency offering services for brands looking to expand their presence across a variety of digital platforms. Our business is expanding globally, and we need talented folks on our team to continue offering stellar service to our clients.

Running a company is a little like building a plane while flying it. There’s always too much to do; doing one thing means neglecting something else. You have to blog but also be active on social media. You have to build websites and then optimize them for mobile. Email lists. Emails. Keywords. SEM. SEO. UX. UI. FML. OMG. That’s where we come in. We provide an unlimited get-shit-done subscription for our clients. And we need your help!

  • Create visually appealing designs for various platforms, including digital, print, social media, and branding.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (marketing, content, etc.) to deliver high-quality design solutions that align with brand guidelines and project goals.

  • Strong experience as a graphic designer, with a portfolio showcasing your skills in visual design, creativity, and problem-solving.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with team members.

Our operating hours are 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. MST, Monday to Friday.

Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Especialista em EHS (Operações e Manufatura)
description:
Resumo do cargo:

Responsável por garantir a conformidade com normas de segurança e promover uma cultura de prevenção em ambientes industriais. Atua na avaliação e mitigação de riscos, implementação de programas de reconhecimento, verificação de conformidade em testes e serviços offshore, além de participar de auditorias periódicas e reuniões globais de EHS.

Nesse cargo, suas responsabilidades serão:

  • Realizar inspeções e auditorias regulares para identificar riscos potenciais e garantir a conformidade com os padrões de segurança;
  • Investigar acidentes e incidentes para determinar as causas raiz e recomendar ações corretivas;
  • Conduzir sessões de treinamento para colaboradores sobre protocolos de segurança, treinamento de liderança em segurança, etc.;
  • Monitoramento de Indicadores Proativos, como comportamentos inseguros/seguros, quase acidentes, primeiros socorros, incidentes e perigos;
  • Preparar e enviar relatórios para a área Corporativa;
  • Identificar e avaliar riscos potenciais e desenvolver estratégias para mitigá-los;
  • Implementar programa de reconhecimento para colaboradores que seguem as regras;
  • Realizar auditorias em campo por cliente (Verificação em Local do Cliente);
  • Verificação de conformidade com Segurança em Testes de Pressão API;
  • Serviços Offshore – verificação de treinamentos e qualificações/certificações;
  • Auditoria Bienal OPEX da Divisão (Segurança, Saúde, Meio Ambiente, Produção, Sistemas de Qualidade, Manutenção);
  • Avaliação Trienal de Higiene Industrial da Divisão;
  • Reuniões Semanais de Segurança (Safety Toolbox Meetings);
  • Participação no Conselho de Segurança da Área Mundial (NASCR) ou reuniões periódicas, reuniões globais de EHS (quinzenais) e reuniões individuais específicas da área mundial (a cada 5 semanas);
  • Fornecer suporte para resposta a emergências.

Quem você é:

Você conecta as pessoas certas para alcançar os objetivos. Você demonstra uma enorme iniciativa em situações desafiadoras e é excepcional em identificar e aproveitar oportunidades. Você comunica mensagens de forma clara e compreensível para diferentes públicos.

Para este cargo, você precisará:

  • Experiência comprovada de mais de 5 anos em funções de Segurança em ambientes de manufatura (preferencialmente Engenharia sob Encomenda e Serviços);
  • Formação em Engenharia (mecânica, automação ou similar) ou Tecnólogo em Segurança;
  • Pós-graduação em Meio Ambiente, Saúde e Segurança;
  • CSP (Profissional de Segurança Certificado) preferencialmente;
  • Inglês avançado a fluente (reuniões regulares com a Unidade de Negócio nos EUA);
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e interpessoais;
  • Capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas;
  • Pensamento estratégico para alinhar Segurança aos objetivos do negócio.

title: Senior FP&A Manager, LATAM
description:
Our Mission At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission: Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life. Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are. Who We Are We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes. Job Description Your Career Palo Alto Networks, Inc. is building a world-class finance organization and is looking for an experienced, top notch Senior Finance Manager to add to the team. The position requires a well-rounded individual who has demonstrated the ability to deliver results in a dynamic fast-paced environment. This person will be responsible for budgeting, forecasting, metrics/KPIs reporting and analysis and business partnering for LATAM Sales as a key member of our Finance team. Your Impact Finance
  • Opex and HC management for Sales, ensuring adherence to Plan, targets
  • Drive the forecasting & consolidation process, ensuring a high degree of accuracy
  • Provide budget vs. actuals analysis, providing meaningful insight on any material variances
  • Meet deliverables, requests from business partners, Corporate FP&A, Accounting and other G&A functions
  • Help Sales organization achieve, meet any compliance/statutory obligations
  • Build a world-class Finance team through hiring, mentorship, and professional development
Business
  • Create reports and predictive financial models pertaining to: Sales team productivity, program analysis & performance, and bookings projections amongst others
  • Create reports and predictive financial models pertaining to: pipeline health, customer analytics, program performance, discounting and bookings projections amongst others
  • Evaluate new go-to-market initiatives, including business plans to expand business, assessing financial impact, viability, etc.
  • Build and maintain dashboards and metrics to identify key trends, risks and opportunities
  • With thorough data analysis, provide insightful and actionable metrics and recommendations
  • Ad hoc and regular analyses of the business to drive a high-level of corporate performance and to assist with executive decision making
  • Collaborate across the company to improve processes and procedures as needed
Qualifications Your Experience
  • BA/BS in finance or related discipline, MBA preferred, and 8-10+ years related experience
  • Record of strong achievement and desire for increased responsibilities
  • Fluent in Portuguese, Spanish & English
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel, Google Suite skills with the ability to analyze large amounts of data and maintain complex financial models
  • Advanced Power BI or Tableau skills with the ability to analyze large amounts of data and maintain complex financial models
  • Experience and expertise in utilization of data, CRM, Planning and ERP systems such as Business Objects, Salesforce.com, SAP, and SAP BPC
  • Experience as a people manager, responsible for hiring and team development
  • Strong business acumen and analytical skills
  • Strong relationship building, communication, and presentation skills
  • Ability and desire to work in a fast-paced and continually evolving environment
  • Experience supporting a high-technology organization strongly desired
  • Experience interacting with Sales is highly appreciated
Please submit your resume in English only so that it can be properly evaluated by the Hiring team. Resumes in other languages, including Portuguese and Spanish, will not be considered for the open role. Additional Information The Team You have a passion for numbers and business, and our organization has a real passion for cybersecurity. You’re looking for a career with a more fulfilling mission. We have open positions to top talent seeking a financial challenge. Our finance department deals with numbers daily, supporting infrastructure, dealing in automation, and building elegant models and solutions to empower our business lines and solutions. If you’re seeking a financial challenge but with a worldwide impact, this is it. Our Commitment We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Somos uma instituição que respeita e valoriza a diversidade humana, e proporcionamos um ambiente ético, desafiador, dinâmico, aberto ao diálogo, à construção coletiva e à aprendizagem contínua. Se esses valores são relevantes para você, junte-se ao nosso time!

title: Especialista de Melhoramento Genético e Genética Quantitativa
description:
No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Objetivos do cargo:

Gerenciar e analisar bases de dados massivas relacionadas a valorização do material genético da companhia, garantindo a rastreabilidade, qualidade e disponibilidade das informações nos sistemas bioinformáticos corporativos. Este papel é essencial para apoiar decisões estratégicas nos programas de melhoramento genético florestal da ARAUCO.

Principais atividades:

  • Gerenciar bases de dados genéticas de grande volume: administração, atualização periódica, análise e geração de relatórios, assegurando integridade e rastreabilidade.
  • Atualizar e reportar anualmente os indicadores de ganho genético para os genótipos das diferentes espécies de interesse.
  • Documentar e atualizar as estratégias de melhoramento genético, alinhadas aos objetivos dos programas desenvolvidos pela Arauco.
  • Avaliar a qualidade e confiabilidade dos dados, aplicando técnicas como delineamento experimental, ANOVA, GLM para dados desbalanceados, análise de dados binários, modelos não lineares e modelos lineares mistos.
  • Criar visualizações gráficas e relatórios executivos utilizando ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Qlik Sense, entre outras).
  • Propor e implementar novas metodologias e indicadores aplicáveis aos processos dos programas de melhoramento genético, promovendo uma cultura de melhoria contínua, inovação e excelência operacional.

Requisitos:

  • Formação superior em Engenharia Florestal, Engenharia Estatística ou área correlata (obrigatório).
  • Pós-graduação ou Especialização em Genética Quantitativa ou áreas relacionadas (desejável).
  • Conhecimento intermediário/avançado em programação em R (desejável).
  • Conhecimento intermediário/avançado em programação em Python (desejável).
  • Domínio intermediário/avançado do Microsoft Office e Excel (obrigatório).
  • Experiência om ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Qlik Sense, etc) para análise e apresentação dos dados (desejável).
  • Inglês em nível intermediário/avançado (desejável).
  • CNH B (obrigatório).

Comunicação Global: Atuar como o principal ponto de contato, facilitando a comunicação clara e eficaz entre o cliente, stakeholders executivos e os times técnicos distribuídos globalmente.

Análise e Requisitos de Dados: Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com analistas de dados e designers para refinar os requisitos de visualização, garantindo que os dashboards atendam às necessidades de informação e apresentem a narrativa correta.

Governança: Estabelecer e manter padrões, processos e métricas de desempenho (KPIs) para o projeto, garantindo a transparência e o alinhamento estratégico.

Mitigação de Riscos: Identificar proativamente riscos e impedimentos, desenvolvendo planos de mitigação e escalando problemas quando necessário.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

Experiência Comprovada: experiência atuando como PMO, Gerente de Projetos ou Product Owner em projetos de alta complexidade e grande escala.

Proficiência em Inglês: Fluência obrigatória (escrita e conversação) para comunicação diária com times e stakeholders internacionais.

Metodologias: Forte conhecimento e experiência prática com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e/ou tradicionais (PMBOK).

Data & DataViz: Sólida compreensão dos conceitos de Data Visualization, Business Intelligence (BI) e Storytelling com dados. Capacidade de entender a estrutura de dados e como ela suporta a visualização final.

Habilidades de Comunicação: Excelente habilidade de comunicação, negociação e gestão de conflitos, com experiência em interagir em nível executivo.

Certificações: Certificações relevantes (e.g., PMP, PSM/CSM, SAFe).

title: Direct-Response Ad Video Editor
description:
VelorHealth is an established and rapidly scaling eCommerce brand operating in the 7–8 figure range. We are looking for a highly skilled Paid Social Video Ad Editor to join our creative performance team.

You will be responsible for editing high-performing ad creatives for Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and other paid channels. This role requires a strong understanding of direct response video editing , split-testing frameworks, and what drives conversions in DTC paid media.

We are not looking for a basic editor. We are looking for someone who understands how to build attention, maintain narrative tension, and convert cold audiences into buyers through video edits engineered for performance—not aesthetics alone.

Responsibilities
  • Edit short-form, performance-optimized video ads for Meta, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and Reels
  • Apply proven performance tactics: strong hooks, fast pacing, dynamic cuts, motion graphics, captions, and retention-driving structure
  • Work with raw UGC, product footage, AI-generated assets, voiceovers, and testimonials
  • Collaborate with creative strategists to interpret scripts, briefings, and messaging frameworks into final ads
  • Use AI video generation tools (Sora 2 or equivalent), plus editing software (Premiere, CapCut, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, etc.)
  • Test multiple creative variations designed for A/B performance testing
  • Continuously optimize edits based on data feedback—CTR, hold rate, thumb-stop ratio, CVR, CPA, etc.
  • Maintain brand consistency across dynamic performance creatives
  • Organize and maintain creative assets for versioning, split testing, and performance tracking
Requirements
  • Proven experience editing direct-response paid social ads (DTC experience strongly preferred)
  • Expertise in modern editing software and workflows
  • Experience leveraging AI creative tools including video, voiceover, motion, and script generation
  • Understanding of attention psychology: hooks, curiosity gaps, pattern interrupts, emotional pacing, and social proof stacking
  • Able to strategically incorporate on-screen text, captions, dynamic transitions, and brand elements to maximize watch time
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced direct-response environment with tight turnaround cycles
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating performance-driven ad editing
Bonus Qualifications
  • Prior experience working with 7–8 figure DTC brands
  • Experience editing UGC ads for Meta/TikTok
  • Familiarity with offer testing frameworks and CRO principles
  • Ability to analyze video performance metrics and iterate based on insights
Why This Role Matters

Every new VelorHealth ad you produce has the potential to reach millions. Your edits directly impact revenue, scale, and our mission to help people move freely, stay pain-free, and regain control of their mobility.

If you want to build high-performing ads for a fast-scaling DTC brand and leverage cutting-edge creative and AI technology, we’d love to meet you.

title: Bolsista Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial - Terris - Desenvolvimento e integração de sistema inteligente para agricultura de precisão
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses , promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado , ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico , favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico . A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências , e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável .

Sobre a Oportunidade:

A Terris é uma indústria de tecnologia para agricultura de precisão com sede na cidade de Pato Branco – Paraná, que desde 2015 Desenvolve soluções tecnológicas que visam uma maior produtividade, diminuição de perdas e economia de insumos.

O objetivo deste projeto é Criar, validar e industrializar um módulo nativo de automação agrícola que permita a aplicação precisa e georreferenciada de insumos líquidos, com redução de sobreposição, aumento de eficiência e integração ao ecossistema já existente da empresa.

Projeto: Desenvolvimento e integração de sistema inteligente de Corte de Seção e Controle de Vazão para máquinas agrícolas.

Formação Acadêmica:

Doutorado completo Engenharia de Software e correlatas / Engenharia da Computação e correlatas.

Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.

Idioma: Inglês técnico

Principais Atividades:

  • Desenvolvimento e integração de sistema inteligente para agricultura de precisão.

Requisitos Técnicos Mínimos

  • Capacitação no desenvolvimento de aplicações front-end e back-end
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais
  • Domínio de princípios de UX/UI
  • Experiência com design responsivo
  • Capacidade de construir fluxos de navegação intuitivos
  • Aplicação de boas práticas de usabilidade
  • Conhecimento em testes de usabilidade
  • Capacidade de construir interfaces compatíveis com ambientes industriais
  • Desenvolvimento de interfaces adaptadas a usuários com diferentes níveis de familiaridade tecnológica.

Requisitos Técnicos Desejáveis / Diferenciais

  • É desejável que tenha especializações em Arquitetura de Sistemas Embarcados, Controle em Tempo Real ou Automação Industrial, bem como formações complementares em desenvolvimento para sistemas críticos.
  • Experiência com máquinas agrícolas.

title: IT Technician Specialist - Brazil (F/M)
description:
Context

Veesion is experiencing rapid growth following its successful Series B funding round. This expansion phase requires strengthening our technical foundation and scaling our development capabilities to meet increasing market demands.

Your Mission

As a Technician at Veesion, you will play a key role in managing and maintaining our product. Your passion for network technologies and your technical expertise will be put to use within the Technical Support team as well as with our clients. You'll have the opportunity to develop your skills and face exciting challenges while contributing to a safer future for retail.

Responsibilities

  • Server Configuration: You will be responsible for configuring our servers before sending them to our clients. Using our OS system, you will execute the necessary commands and record the details in our inventory.

You will also conduct in-depth analyses of camera systems and network architectures, configuring the system based on their needs and ensuring compatibility with the RTSP protocol.

  • Ticket Management and Follow-Up: You will use our ticketing tools to ensure proper tracking of client requests.
  • Data Analysis and Reporting: You will regularly monitor server performance using graphical software (Grafana) and ensure optimal operation.
  • Customized Configuration for Each Client: You will configure our system based on each client’s specific needs, ensuring a solution tailored to their requirements.

Required Skills

  • You're Native in Portuguese and Fluent/Advanced in English;
  • You are eager to join a young, dynamic, and ambitious tech startup;
  • You are a true problem solver and can quickly find solutions;
  • You have a genuine interest in IT and strong technical knowledge;
  • You can work autonomously and manage priorities and deadlines effectively;
  • You have experience working with networks.

Nice to have

  • You have already had a similar experience in a startup ecosystem.
  • You have experience in IP network configuration.

Benefits

  • The candidate have to be based in São Paulo, Brazil;
  • Contractor Hiring Model (PJ);
  • Opportunity to grow within a fast-growing multinational company;
  • Collaborative and dynamic work environment.

A fast and transparent recruitment process

We are committed to providing you with a quick, three-step recruitment process:

  1. A first interview with our talent acquisition specialist.
  2. A second interview with our technical expert.
  3. An interview with our operations manager.

School of the Nations is an authorized International Baccalaureate (IB) School offering the Primary Years (PYP) and the Diploma (DP) Programs. Accredited as an international school by NEASC, our strategic development is guided by the ACE Learning Ecosystem 2.0.

Shared Understanding of High-Quality Learning

High-quality learning at the School of the Nations is rooted in our aspiration to release human potential through academic excellence, moral and spiritual qualities, and a lifelong commitment to service, empowering learners to develop the capacities of heart and mind to understand the world and contribute to the betterment of society.

In an inclusive, diverse, and globally-minded community, our students develop cognitive, creative, physical, spiritual, and social-emotional abilities; learners are agents of their own learning, actively setting goals, engaging in rich and complex challenges, and documenting growth; they demonstrate depth of understanding, collaboration, reflection, and multiple perspectives across disciplines.

Learning happens through a coherent, inquiry-based curriculum grounded in spiritual principles and practical applications, with diverse assessment and feedback guiding meaningful growth.

School of the Nations is an equal-opportunity employer. We encourage people with disability to apply.

A aprendizagem de alta qualidade na Escola das Nações está enraizada em nossa aspiração de liberar o potencial humano por meio da excelência acadêmica, do desenvolvimento de qualidades morais e espirituais e de um compromisso contínuo com o serviço, capacitando os alunos a desenvolverem as capacidades do coração e da mente para compreender o mundo e contribuir para o aprimoramento da sociedade.

A aprendizagem acontece por meio de um currículo coerente e baseado na investigação, fundamentado em princípios espirituais e aplicações práticas, com avaliações diversificadas e feedback que orientam um desenvolvimento significativo.

title: Junior Developer (Devvit Platform)
description:
We're looking for a Junior Developer 100% remote in Brazil

Location: Remote (100%)

Employment Type: CLT

About the Role

We are seeking a skilled Junior Developer to lead the creation of engaging, high-performance in-app community experiences aligned with major UK cultural moments. This role blends full-stack development with a deep understanding of online communities, culture, and data-driven iteration. You will own the full lifecycle of features—from concept to deployment—while collaborating closely with cross-functional partners to drive meaningful user engagement during peak activity periods.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the conceptualisation, design, and execution of in-app community experiences tailored to high-interest UK cultural moments.
  • Drive community engagement during peak user periods by launching client-facing, technically robust features built on the Devvit Developer Platform.
  • Translate cultural trends and community needs into scalable, high-performance web applications within a large social platform ecosystem.
  • Own the full development lifecycle, from ideation and prototyping through deployment and iteration.
  • Develop a deep understanding of the culture and technical needs of focus communities to inform content, feature sets, and engagement strategies.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to convert strategic growth goals and community feedback into clear technical requirements and deliverables.
  • Conduct data analysis and research on application performance and usage metrics to guide feature prioritisation and optimisation.

Technical Requirements

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in full-stack web development using JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS .
  • Demonstrable expertise with modern client-side frameworks, particularly React .
  • Experience building and deploying server-side applications using Node.js , preferably with frameworks such as Express or Koa .
  • Strong understanding of API integration, data modelling, and client/server architecture patterns.
  • Experience managing application state and data using tools such as Redis for caching or storage.
  • Familiarity with the Devvit Developer Platform and its SDKs (@devvit/client, @devvit/server) is highly desirable.

General Requirements

  • Fluent in English , with a deep understanding of UK culture and language nuances.
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple development and community launch cycles simultaneously.
  • Experience designing and executing community activations and interactive platform experiences.
  • Strong familiarity with large-scale online discussion platforms and user expectations.
  • Ability to quickly understand and adapt to diverse topics and content verticals.
  • Availability to dedicate 20–40 hours per week to community growth initiatives.

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to work on high-impact community experiences tied to major cultural moments.
  • Autonomy to own features end-to-end in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Flexible contract hours within a globally distributed team.

If you are passionate about building community-driven products and enjoy combining cultural insight with technical excellence, we’d love to hear from you.

  • Coordenar a interface técnica e operacional com equipes e gestores chineses da CCCC, assegurando comunicação clara, alinhamento técnico e respeito às diferenças culturais;
  • Garantir a correta mobilização e utilização de mão de obra, equipamentos e materiais, em conjunto com as áreas responsáveis;
  • Monitorar indicadores de desempenho da produção, como produtividade, avanço físico, retrabalho e custos diretos, propondo melhorias contínuas;
  • Apoiar medições de serviços executados, validação de quantidades e informações técnicas para fins de controle e faturamento;
  • Garantir o cumprimento rigoroso das normas de Segurança, Saúde e Meio Ambiente (SMS), promovendo cultura de prevenção no canteiro de obras;
  • Participar de reuniões com cliente, fiscalização, parceiros e equipes internas, apresentando resultados, análises e planos de ação;
  • Contribuir para a gestão de riscos da obra, antecipando interferências técnicas, operacionais e logísticas;

  • Sólida experiência em execução de obras rodoviárias , preferencialmente em projetos de médio e grande porte;
  • Conhecimento abrangente de normas, regulamentos e boas práticas do setor de infraestrutura ;
  • Inglês avançado (obrigatório) para atuação em ambiente multicultural;
  • Domínio do Pacote Office Avançado , especialmente Excel para controle e análise de dados;

A Concremat acredita que a diversidade impulsiona a inovação e melhora nossos produtos e serviços. Promover a equidade e a inclusão gera novas ideias e contribui para uma sociedade mais justa. description:
Ei, quer trabalhar em uma empresa com plano de carreira que coloca você como protagonista?

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior. Nossos 3 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.

  • O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

Profissional com sólida experiência em administração de sistemas Linux e Windows, forte atuação em ambientes cloud AWS e domínio de práticas DevOps.

Vivência com Kubernetes, Docker e ferramentas de observabilidade/monitoramento em tempo real.

Também é importante que tenha habilidade em criação e manutenção de scripts de automação (Python, Bash ou PowerShell).

Diferenciais desejáveis:

– Conhecimento em redes (protocolos, configuração e segurança).

– Experiência com middleware, especialmente Oracle WebLogic.

– Atuação com gestão de vulnerabilidades e aplicação de patches.

– Certificações em SRE, DevOps ou Administração de Sistemas.

  • O que temos para te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 etapas:

- Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

- Mobilidade Interna: Você quer um novo rumo profissional? Aqui dentro de casa temos diversas opções diferentes e o programa de mobilidade interna, que te permite mudar de área, por exemplo.

- Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

- Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Previdência Privada; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

title: Scheduling Optimization Engineer
description:
About You

You are a data-driven professional passionate about solving complex scheduling and resource allocation challenges. You thrive on applying advanced optimization techniques to real-world problems, balancing mathematical rigor with practical feasibility. With strong analytical and modeling skills, you design solutions that improve efficiency, reduce costs, and ensure compliance with operational and regulatory requirements.

You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Advanced knowledge of optimization modeling (integer programming, constraint programming, heuristics/metaheuristics).
  • Proven experience developing and maintaining large-scale scheduling models in applied environments.
  • Ability to incorporate operational rules, contractual agreements, regulatory requirements, and business constraints into model formulations.
  • Hands-on experience with optimization solvers (e.g., Gurobi, CPLEX, OR-Tools).
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Julia, or C++.
  • Strong understanding of data analysis for planning based on event calendars, service times, passenger volumes, and destination planning.
  • Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication skills to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain advanced optimization models to solve large-scale scheduling problems.

  • Integrate operational rules, contractual obligations, regulatory requirements, and business constraints into model formulations.
  • Apply optimization solvers (Gurobi, CPLEX, OR-Tools) to generate feasible, efficient schedules.
  • Collaborate with operations, planning, and technology teams to align outputs with real-world needs.
  • Analyze results to identify cost savings, efficiency improvements, and compliance risks.
  • Continuously refine models to adapt to changes in resource availability, demand patterns, and operational constraints.

title: Revenue Operations Specialist
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Revenue Operations Specialist with 3 to 6 years of experience in revenue and sales operations to support our U.S. client's growing go-to-market organization. You will be responsible for managing and improving processes that drive revenue visibility and efficiency, including Salesforce administration, pipeline analytics, quote-to-cash workflows, and services operations coordination.

This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Services, and Systems, ensuring operational excellence across the full customer lifecycle. The ideal candidate is a systems thinker who thrives on process optimization, data accuracy, and cross-functional collaboration.

Our client provides a cloud-based ERP platform to hundreds of energy industry customers, delivering market-leading software solutions for field service management, field data gathering, transportation, production, accounting, and land management. Backed by private equity, our client accelerates business performance, improves operational efficiency, and reduces costs.

Responsibilities

Sales Operations

  • Own and optimize Salesforce processes for the Sales and Account Management teams, including lead management, opportunity tracking, forecasting, and pipeline hygiene
  • Partner with Sales Leadership to develop and maintain dashboards, metrics, and reports that provide visibility into bookings performance, funnel conversion, and forecast accuracy
  • Support commission plan execution by maintaining accurate opportunity data, product configurations, and close dates
  • Coordinate with Finance and Legal on deal review processes, ensuring consistency between quotes, contracts, and billing data

Services Operations

  • Support Professional Services leadership with project setup, time tracking, and revenue recognition workflows in coordination with Finance
  • Track utilization, backlog, and project profitability metrics to ensure delivery teams have accurate performance visibility
  • Partner with the Project Management Office (PMO) and Delivery to standardize statements of work (SOWs), rate cards, and project milestone tracking
  • Drive continuous improvement in services data quality across CRM, PSA, and billing systems

CRM and Systems Administration

  • Serve as the Salesforce (SFDC) administrator for all go-to-market (GTM) functions - including user management, profiles, validation rules, and custom workflows
  • Maintain integrations with related systems to ensure data synchronization and process automation
  • Implement enhancements and new functionality as business requirements evolve, documenting changes and training users accordingly
  • Manage user support requests, troubleshoot data discrepancies, and ensure compliance with data governance standards

Data and Reporting

  • Develop recurring and ad hoc reports to support revenue forecasting, KPI reviews, and board-level insights
  • Audit data for accuracy and completeness across systems; proactively resolve inconsistencies or bottlenecks
  • Partner with finance, sales, and marketing leadership to define and monitor core GTM metrics, including customer acquisition cost (CAC) payback, annual recurring revenue (ARR) growth, churn, and expansion rates.

Contracts

  • Track and respond to internal questions regarding contract terms, pricing, and commercial conditions, partnering closely with Finance and Legal as needed.
  • Support contract lifecycle management by monitoring stated terms and addressing internal stakeholder inquiries to ensure accuracy and compliance.

Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written skills
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, or a related field
  • 3 to 6 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or similar analytical GTM roles
  • Advanced proficiency with Salesforce CRM
  • Experience with SaaS business models, including ARR tracking, renewals, and professional services revenue workflows
  • Strong Excel and reporting skills
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills with a bias for action and detail orientation
  • Must be a self-starter and resourceful
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team
  • Proven experience working effectively in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent

Desired Experience

  • Master of Business Administration degree
  • Salesforce administration certification
  • Familiarity with HubSpot, NetSuite, or PSA tools (e.g., Mavenlink, Kantata, FinancialForce)
  • Power BI or Tableau experience
  • Experience with oil and gas revenue accounting, gas processing, crude/gas/NGL transportation, or related fields

Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: "Vendedor #987865"

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho:
